interpretation.measurement: Derived comparison of archival third-party measurements and separately dated cloud rental prices; no newly executed workload experiment.
interpretation.matching: All 69 static-web configurations and 6 Redis configurations shared across three 16-vCPU, 64-GiB AWS product sizes; identical task hashes and same recorded server/tool versions. Redis memtier client version is not recorded and is not pinned. Intel exposes 8 physical cores with SMT while AMD/Arm expose 16 cores. Dates and binaries are not identical.
interpretation.purpose: Evidence that customer choice depends on completed-work economics and software/workload fit. A low advertised cloud price or higher CPU package ASP alone cannot validate the investment thesis.
interpretation.pricing_scope: Linux, Shared tenancy, No License required, NA preinstalled software, Used capacity, OnDemand in us-east-1 per Spare Cores crawler filter; no EBS, network, discounts, tax, migration or licenses. Measured server and client share the VM.
interpretation.license: Spare Cores raw records CC BY-SA 4.0. All ratios are our derived calculations, not reported manufacturer comparisons.
interpretation.configuration_count_warning: 75 parameter configurations are correlated observations on three archived VM test runs, not 75 independent experiments. There are no confidence intervals or population-level statistical claims.
interpretation.latency_warning: No independent production service-level objective was specified. Mean latency is retained with each throughput observation and descriptive dominance is counted; there are no tail-latency measurements in these files. No-worse latency is a post-computation robustness diagnostic, not a claim of an ex ante threshold.
interpretation.Redis_aggregation: rps sums SET operations per second from all client processes. Latency is the unweighted mean of each client's mean; it is not an operation-weighted mean. One client/server pair is launched per CPU in the container affinity set. A positive aggregate does not prove every client succeeded.
interpretation.harness_error_limits: Redis harness does not enforce memtier exit codes or successful flush. Static-web failed counts only non-2xx/3xx responses; connect/read/write/timeout errors are not saved. Task exit zero and failed zero do not establish error-free execution.
interpretation.run_design: Each workload configuration runs once for 10 seconds, with no warmup or repetitions. Both workloads use loopback. Redis tests SET only; static-web tests zero-filled in-memory cached files over plain HTTP.
interpretation.post_audit_disposition: Exploratory comparison of reported benchmark throughput normalized by current rental price. Do not present this as validated production request cost, a controlled experiment, or definitive CPU economics. Missing per-client/error records cannot be repaired from these aggregate outputs.
